newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Ossia to expand Asian distribution.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Ossia to expand Asian distribution.

text.p: Singapore sporting goods and apparel dealer Ossia International Ltd said on Monday it plans to boost distribution channels in Asia Pacific, including China.
"In terms of distribution, China is definitely one of the key markets," Joe Goh, group managing director, told reporters at the launch of Ossia's initial public offer.
Company officials said Ossia would not set up any of its own stores in China, although the company was considering setting up a plant in China.

Ossia launched its initial public offering of 50 million shares at S$0.61 each on Monday. The company distributes sports brands like Prince, Rollerblade and K-Swiss and manufactures ladies shoes, bags and accessories.

According to the company's prospectus, it is negotiating for distribution rights and the acquisition of a line of active-wear in Australia and also the distribution rights to several brands of sporting goods in Hong Kong.
Its top two brands, Prince and Rollerblade, contributed 29.6 percent of the company's turnover in 1995 and this is seen declining as more brands are introduced.
For the six months ended June 30 1996, it recorded a net profit of S$3.2 million on a turnover of S$48.2 million.
